::: {#def-logical-equivalence}
#### Logical equivalence

Two propositions $A$ and $B$ built from the same propositions $P_1, \ldots, P_n$
are **logically equivalent**, written $A \equiv B$,
if they have the same truth value in every row of a truth table (@def-truth-table),
that is, for every combination of truth values of $P_1, \ldots, P_n$.

:::
